novelty: New UberBond mechanism relative to the 17 momentum/carry/baseline experiments; established in public research, not a claim of world novelty.
question: Can an outsider observe a same-market YES+NO purchase below one unit of deterministic terminal payoff after depth, minimum size, fees and delay, without using midpoint prices as fills?
hypothesis: Most apparent probability contradictions vanish when executable ask depth, fees and available position transformations are used.
scope: Single binary markets only. No cross-market semantic relations, no negative-risk conversion assumption, no market orders, no account, no keys.

initialFeasibilitySample.selection: First two returned markets, no substitution after seeing results; explicitly nonrandom convenience sample.

futureStudyNotStarted.sample: First 100 binary markets accepting orders from a frozen public discovery snapshot, including those with no books or disallowed metadata; never exclude losing or failed cases.
futureStudyNotStarted.frequency: At most three manually initiated snapshots 30 seconds apart; no scheduler or always-on claim.
futureStudyNotStarted.costModel: Sum ask-side volume-weighted fill for each leg at the greater venue minimum. Read exact per-market fee; missing fee means UNKNOWN and cannot qualify. Include 1% adverse price move per leg stress and 50% displayed-depth haircut. No maker-fill or rebate assumption.
futureStudyNotStarted.microcapitalTest: Test capital budgets 1, 10 and 100 USD equivalent separately; reject infeasible minimum size. No financing, shorting or leverage.
futureStudyNotStarted.latencyTest: Candidate must still qualify at next snapshot using new asks and reduced depth. This cannot prove a fill or atomic execution.
futureStudyNotStarted.promotion: At least 30 distinct qualifying events on three separate dates after fees and stress, complete frozen sample, independently reviewed payout equivalence, local-law/platform access and authorized capital. Still only a paper-study promotion.
futureStudyNotStarted.failure: Zero qualifying complete events, missing critical fields, or all apparent spreads consumed by cost/size/delay. Preserve all rows.
futureStudyNotStarted.statistics: Descriptive feasibility proportions with denominator; no p-value, Sharpe, profit or calibrated probability claim from the initial two-market feasibility sample.
futureStudyNotStarted.stop: Any authentication demand, rate limit, cost, geoblock or need to place order stops collection. Never evade controls. Maximum two founder-free analysis hours before further allocation.

preregistrationBoundary: Locally written and hashed before the new feasibility snapshot, but not externally timestamped or immutable. Parent must preserve the exact file hash in a durable commit before any future outcome evaluation. No claim of historical preregistration.

founderIdeaDonors.role: Timestamp predictions and reconcile outcomes; exact body read from original shard.
Carry provenance, assumptions, falsifiers and update history; exact body read.
